questions.title: How are you feeling today?
questions.subtitle: Choose the one that fits today best.
descriptions: Everything feels overwhelming.
I feel a bit down and not very cheerful.
I'm doing okay and managing things.
I'm feeling happy today.
I feel light, calm, and at ease.
questions.help: There's no wrong answer — just how today feels.

questions.title: How did you sleep last night? (even if you woke up often)
descriptions: Feels like I didn't get any real rest.
I was awake on and off almost all night.
I got some sleep, but woke up often.
I got enough sleep to feel somewhat rested.
I slept soundly and woke up feeling refreshed.
questions.help: Broken sleep is normal right now. No need for perfect sleep.

questions.title: How much energy do you have today?
questions.subtitle: At your own pace, not anyone else's.
descriptions: I feel completely drained and worn out.
I'm feeling tired and low on energy.
I have enough energy to get through what I need to do.
I can go about my day as usual.
I feel full of energy and ready for the day.

questions.title: How much is on your mind today?
questions.subtitle: Whatever is there is okay to name.
descriptions: My mind feels clear and at ease.
I have a few things on my mind, but I'm managing well.
My thoughts keep circling, but I can still manage.
My mind feels crowded with too many thoughts.
My thoughts feel overwhelming, and I don't know where to begin.

problemTags.title: What feels hardest today?

epds.title: Emotional Check
epds.sensitiveNote: If this feels urgent, use I Need Help right away. Answer honestly and keep going at your pace.
epds.scoreExplain: This is your Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) score. It's a screening tool, not a diagnosis — your care team can help you make sense of it.

crisisCards.recommendSupportBody: Please open help right now and reach out to a doctor, midwife, or crisis line.
crisisCards.noticedLastAnswerBody: If those thoughts ever feel urgent, open help immediately. You matter deeply and support is available now.

gentle.body: Your answers point to early strain. Gentle support and simple next steps can help keep this from building.

extra.quote: You do not have to carry this stretch alone.

immediate.body: Your answers point to a high-need moment. Please open help right now and contact support immediately.

steady.label: Steady
steady.message:
You're doing a wonderful job taking care of both yourself and your baby today. ✨

We're proud of the care and dedication you've shown. Take things one step at a time, and move at a pace that feels right for you.

gentle.label: Gentle Support
gentle.message:
It seems like you may be carrying a lot right now. 🤍

Whenever you can, please remember to take a moment to rest and be kind to yourself. Every little bit of self-care matters.

extra.label: Extra Support Recommended
extra.message:
Today seems to be especially challenging. 💗

Please remember, you're not alone. We're here to support you every step of the way.

immediate.label: Immediate Support
immediate.message:
You don't have to face this by yourself. 💗

Caring support is here whenever you're ready to reach out.
